newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian stocks end ahead as Radex surges.
newsitem.headline: Austrian stocks end ahead as Radex surges.

text.p: Austria's blue-chip ATX index ended a shade higher on Monday, defying weak international leads, but failed to hold above 1,200 points hit earlier.
Traders said all eyes would remain on how Wall Street fares to try and gauge future market direction and see ATX hemmed into a 1,170 to 1,200-point range in the short term.
The ATX index added on 2.21 points or 0.19 percent to 1,194.14 after earlier rising to 1,205.84. Of its constituents, seven gained, 12 fell and two were unchanged by the close.
"There was too little volume for a close above 1,200 points," lamented one trader.
The day's best performing stock was fireproof materials maker Radex-Heraklith, up 3.41 percent at 462.95 ATS while fibremaker Lenzing led decliners, losing 1.33 percent at 699.60 ATS.
Traders said Radex continued to see good demand after announcing a 700-million ATS contract from South Africa on Friday.
Wienerberger, attracted some "speculative money" ahead of the release of its 1996 results tomorrow, another trader said. The stock added on 61 ATS to 2,250.

Traders also cited demand in VA Tech, which initially rose to a session high of 1,846 ATS, before slipping back to end 24 ATS lower at 1,800. "VA Tech managed to hold onto 1,800," said one trader, adding there was still room on the upside.
The all-share Vienna Bourse index inched up 0.4 points, or 0.09 percent, to 451.37.
The May ATX future gained 2.5 points to 1,187.5 on volume of 690 contracts.
